khm.text: Niko Aris arrives on Kaldheim and is accepted by Fynn's Kannah band, where Kjell mentors them and Niko wins a stone-skipping bet for peace-gift armor at the Jutmaw longhall.

Fynn dreams that the Cosmos Serpent will break its cage and swallow the light of Starnheim, and when a brawl stirred up by Birgi turns out to be her way of letting Niko know the gods, Niko offers to be sent to Starnheim with a warning.

Orhaft guides a ship carrying Niko through an Omenpath into Starnheim, where Niko delivers the warning, and when Koma tears into the sky Niko proposes luring it like a cat chasing toys back out through an Omenpath.

With Valkyries baiting the serpent and Niko's mirror traps hiding their bodies, Koma crashes through the hole and out of Starnheim, and Avtyr catches Niko as they nearly fall in and flies down with them into the battle.

dsk.text: In Duskmourn: House of Horror, Niko Aris joins Kaito, Tyvar, Zimone and the Wanderer when they travel to Duskmourn to retrieve Nashi, and the door they came through vanishes behind them.
Niko holds the Wanderer back from jumping after Kaito and later argues that Phyrexia is to blame when she admits she killed Nashi's mother.
With the guide Winter, Niko traps a ghost in a shard and then rescues Nashi from wickerfolk by throwing a shard that carries him out of the cage.
Winter then betrays the group, and the Cult of Valgavoth captures Niko, the Wanderer and Nashi, and Niko feels betrayed by their only ally in the House.
